title: Spiral Matrix
statement_short: Given an m x n matrix, return all elements of the matrix in spiral order.
constraints: m == matrix.length, n == matrix[i].length, 1 <= m, n <= 10, -100 <= matrix[i][j] <= 100
hint: Small matrix size (<= 10x10) allows simulating spiral traversal by shrinking four boundary pointers.
why_not: Right: Two Pointers (four boundary pointers: top, bottom, left, right) shrink inward to traverse all matrix elements in O(m \* n) time and O(1) extra space. Not 2D DP: Dynamic programming subproblem state memoization does not apply to sequential traversal order. Not Graph DFS: DFS requires tracking visited cells with extra O(m \* n) memory, whereas boundary pointers use O(1) space. Not Math / Geometry: While direction vectors simulate turning, boundary pointers provide a cleaner deterministic loop condition without direction state management.
